q: Is the Commission's CBAM emissions report template mandatory for suppliers?
title: CBAM operator emissions report template
short: Yes. Where embedded emissions are based on actual data, the operator must prepare an annual operator's emissions report and a summary using the Commission's template. It is in English, so buyers in any member state find the same data in the same fields.
audience: Indian installation operators preparing CBAM data for EU buyers

ul: Emissions by production process and by 8-digit CN code.
A summary report generated automatically from the Excel version.

p: Where electricity emissions are based on actual data, a declarant-specific addendum is also needed.
After the calendar year closes and verification is complete. Until the next year's report is ready, the latest verified one is used.

senseible: Senseible reads an exporter's fuel and electricity invoices into dated, fingerprinted records that a monitoring plan and a verifier can trace back to source. Senseible does not verify emissions, register operators in the CBAM Registry or file CBAM declarations.
